## History

During [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's return to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, Gertie Pye was among the schoolmates who warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne.md) back to the classroom. Gertie later participated alongside the other local children in a successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. At the event, she performed in the show where Anne's recitations were particularly celebrated.
